cat > build_structure.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

lig=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CC(C)c1cccc(C(C)C)c1N(P(c1ccccc1)c1ccccc1)[Ge](Cl)Cl'))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(lig,randomSeed=112)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(lig,maxIters=1500)
base=np.array(lig.GetConformer().GetPositions())
nL=lig.GetNumAtoms()
cp=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[c-]1(C)c(C)c(C)c(C)c1C'))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(cp,randomSeed=22)
AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(cp,maxIters=1500)
cpbase=np.array(cp.GetConformer().GetPositions())
nC=cp.GetNumAtoms()
N=12; P=13; G=26
n=np.zeros(3);p=np.array([1.73,0.,0.]);g=1.90*np.array([np.cos(np.deg2rad(105)),np.sin(np.deg2rad(105)),0])
v=(g-p)/np.linalg.norm(g-p);d=np.linalg.norm(g-p)
a=(2.26**2-2.43**2+d*d)/(2*d);h=np.sqrt(2.26**2-a*a)
r=p+a*v+h*np.array([v[1],-v[0],0])
unit=lambda v:v/np.linalg.norm(v)

def free_dirs(a,b):
 bis=-unit(unit(a)+unit(b));z=unit(np.cross(a,b))
 return [bis/np.sqrt(3)+z*np.sqrt(2/3),bis/np.sqrt(3)-z*np.sqrt(2/3)]
phdirs=free_dirs(n-p,r-p)
cldirs=free_dirs(n-g,r-g)
clRh=r+2.39*np.array([0.,0.,-1.])
axis=-unit(unit(p-r)+unit(g-r)+np.array([0,0,-1.]))
cent=r+1.84*axis
ex=unit(np.cross(axis,[0.,0.,1.]));ey=np.cross(axis,ex)
ring=[a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtoms() if a.GetIsAromatic()]
blocked={N,P,G,27,28}
frags=[];seen=set(blocked)
for root in [11,14,20]:
 stack=[root];component=[];seen.add(root)
 while stack:
  i=stack.pop();component.append(i)
  for nb in lig.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
   j=nb.GetIdx()
   if j not in seen:seen.add(j);stack.append(j)
 frags.append(component)
ffL=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(lig)
ffC=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(cp)
symbols=[a.GetSymbol() for a in lig.GetAtoms()]+[a.GetSymbol() for a in cp.GetAtoms()]+['Rh','Cl']
fixedL={12,13,26,27,28,11,14,20}
fixedCp=set(ring)
fixed=sorted(fixedL|{nL+i for i in fixedCp}|{nL+nC,nL+nC+1})
free=np.array([i for i in range(len(symbols)) if i not in fixed])
radii={'H':1.10,'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'P':1.80,'Ge':1.95,'Cl':1.75,'Rh':1.65}
pairs=[]
for i in range(nL):
 for j in range(nL,nL+nC):pairs.append((i,j))
 for j in [nL+nC,nL+nC+1]:
  if i in [12,13,26,27,28,14,20]:continue
  pairs.append((i,j))
for i in range(nL,nL+nC):pairs.append((i,nL+nC+1))
pa=np.array([a for a,b in pairs]);pb=np.array([b for a,b in pairs])
cut=np.array([.91*(radii[symbols[a]]+radii[symbols[b]]) for a,b in pairs])
def rotation_between(a,b):
 a=unit(a);b=unit(b);cross=np.cross(a,b);s=np.linalg.norm(cross);dot=np.dot(a,b)
 if s<1e-9:return np.eye(3) if dot>0 else Rotation.from_rotvec(np.pi*unit(np.cross(a,[1,0,0]))).as_matrix()
 return Rotation.from_rotvec(unit(cross)*np.arctan2(s,dot)).as_matrix()
def init(seed):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
 xyz=np.zeros((len(symbols),3));xyz[N]=n;xyz[P]=p;xyz[G]=g
 xyz[27]=g+2.20*cldirs[0];xyz[28]=g+2.20*cldirs[1]
 ardir=-unit(unit(p-n)+unit(g-n))
 for frag,ip,core,target,bl in zip(frags,[11,14,20],[N,P,P],[ardir]+phdirs,[1.41,1.84,1.84]):
  rot=rotation_between(base[ip]-base[core],target)
  tw=Rotation.from_rotvec(target*rng.uniform(-np.pi,np.pi)).as_matrix()
  xyz[frag]=(base[frag]-base[ip])@(tw@rot).T+xyz[core]+bl*target
 phase=rng.uniform(0,2*np.pi/5)
 for k,ci in enumerate(ring):
  theta=phase+k*2*np.pi/5
  radial=np.cos(theta)*ex+np.sin(theta)*ey
  xyz[nL+ci]=cent+1.21*radial
  mi=[a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtomWithIdx(ci).GetNeighbors() if not a.GetIsAromatic()][0]
  mh=[a.GetIdx() for a in cp.GetAtomWithIdx(mi).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H']
  xyz[nL+mi]=cent+2.715*radial
  rot=rotation_between(cpbase[mi]-cpbase[ci],radial)
  tw=Rotation.from_rotvec(radial*rng.uniform(-np.pi,np.pi)).as_matrix()
  xyz[[nL+hi for hi in mh]]=(cpbase[mh]-cpbase[mi])@(tw@rot).T+xyz[nL+mi]
 xyz[nL+nC]=r;xyz[nL+nC+1]=clRh
 return xyz
best=None
for seed in range(8):
 xyz0=init(500+seed)
 def objective(vec):
  xyz=xyz0.copy();xyz[free]=vec.reshape(-1,3)
  lcoords=xyz[:nL].ravel().tolist();ccoords=xyz[nL:nL+nC].ravel().tolist()
  E=ffL.CalcEnergy(lcoords)+ffC.CalcEnergy(ccoords)
  grad=np.zeros_like(xyz)
  grad[:nL]=np.array(ffL.CalcGrad(lcoords)).reshape(-1,3)
  grad[nL:nL+nC]=np.array(ffC.CalcGrad(ccoords)).reshape(-1,3)
  dr=xyz[pa]-xyz[pb];dist=np.sqrt(np.sum(dr*dr,axis=1)+1e-12)
  overlap=np.maximum(cut-dist,0)
  E+=30*np.dot(overlap,overlap)
  dp=(-60*overlap/dist)[:,None]*dr
  np.add.at(grad,pa,dp);np.add.at(grad,pb,-dp)
  return E,grad[free].ravel()
 opt=minimize(objective,xyz0[free].ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',options={'maxiter':1400,'ftol':1e-10,'gtol':1e-4,'maxls':40})
 xyz=xyz0.copy();xyz[free]=opt.x.reshape(-1,3)
 print(seed,opt.fun,opt.success,opt.nit,flush=True)
 if best is None or opt.fun<best[0]:best=(opt.fun,xyz)
xyz=best[1];xyz-=xyz.mean(axis=0)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(str(len(symbols))+'\n')
 f.write('Cp*RhCl chelate with N-(2,6-diisopropylphenyl), PPh2 and GeCl2; angstrom\n')
 for sym,pos in zip(symbols,xyz):f.write(f'{sym:2s} {pos[0]: .8f} {pos[1]: .8f} {pos[2]: .8f}\n')
np.save('coords.npy',xyz)
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(10,9));ax=fig.add_subplot(111,projection='3d')
colors={'C':'#555555','H':'#dddddd','N':'blue','P':'orange','Ge':'purple','Rh':'#aa6633','Cl':'green'}
for i,s in enumerate(symbols):
 ax.scatter(*xyz[i],s=95 if s!='H' else 17,c=colors[s],edgecolor='k',linewidth=.3,depthshade=False)
 if s not in ['C','H']:ax.text(*xyz[i],s)
for mol,off in [(lig,0),(cp,nL)]:
 for b in mol.GetBonds():
  q=xyz[[off+b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),off+b.GetEndAtomIdx()]]
  ax.plot(q[:,0],q[:,1],q[:,2],c='#777777',lw=1.5)
for a,b in [(P,nL+nC),(G,nL+nC),(nL+nC,nL+nC+1)]+[(nL+i,nL+nC) for i in ring]:
 q=xyz[[a,b]];ax.plot(q[:,0],q[:,1],q[:,2],c='#aa6633',lw=1.2)
ax.set_box_aspect([1,1,1]);ax.view_init(elev=25,azim=-50);plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('geometry.png',dpi=150)
print('Wrote answer.xyz with',len(symbols),'atoms. Energy',best[0])
PY
